title: Poultry HPAI Interactome: Integrated Computational & Diagnostic Surveillance of Avian Influenza Host-Pathogen Protein Interactions
description: High-throughput multi-omics sequencing and structural interactome modeling of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI H5N1). Modeling inter-species transmission barriers, reassortment dynamics, and host response across avian and mammalian hosts using containerized Nextflow pipelines.

title: Integrated Genomic Surveillance of Emerging Avian Metapneumovirus Subtypes A and B in US Poultry Flocks
description: Targeted amplicon sequencing and phylogenetic tracking of emerging aMPV subtypes. Resolving lineage shifts, transmission networks, and evolutionary divergence in US poultry flocks to support rapid diagnostic intervention.

title: Rapid Outbreak Response: Broad-Spectrum Vaccine and Diagnostics for Avian Metapneumovirus
agency: Foundation for Food & Agriculture Research (FFAR) ROAR
description: Rapid development and validation of diagnostic assays and vaccine candidate evaluations to combat immediate respiratory viral outbreaks in commercial agricultural flocks.

title: Avian Metapneumovirus Diagnostic-Assay Development and Outbreak Control
description: Designed high-sensitivity molecular assays and computational typing workflows for field pathogen identification and outbreak mitigation.
